question: Which of the following visual features is predominantly carved into the left surface of the central stone element?
options: Lines of ancient script or inscriptions
Stylized animal figures in high relief
A smooth, polished surface with reflective qualities
correct_semantic_answer: The left surface of the central stone element is covered with carved lines of ancient script or inscriptions.
visual_evidence: The left half of the prominent vertical stone slab is entirely covered with multiple horizontal lines of carved characters, forming an ancient script, from top to bottom.
